description: A PostHog annotation: a note pinned to a point in time (a release, incident or campaign) and shown on insight charts in a project, an organization, a dashboard or a single insight.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the annotation belongs to.

Content.description: Annotation text shown on charts to describe the change, release or incident.

DateMarker.description: When the annotation happened (ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-05-01T12:00:00Z). Used to position it on charts.

CreationType.description: Who created the annotation: `USR` for user-created notes, `GIT` for bot or deployment notes. Defaults to `USR`.

Scope.description: Where the annotation is shown: `project` (every insight in the project), `organization` (every project in the organization), `dashboard` (insights on the dashboard in DashboardId) or `dashboard_item` (only the insight in DashboardItem).

DashboardItem.description: ID of the insight to attach the annotation to (for scope `dashboard_item`). Must belong to the same project.

DashboardId.description: ID of the dashboard to attach the annotation to (for scope `dashboard`). Must belong to the same project.

Emoji.description: Optional emoji shown in place of the default badge on charts.

HiddenInUserInterface.description: When true, the annotation is hidden from the PostHog UI (charts and the annotations list) but still readable over the API. Use for high-frequency markers such as deployments.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change.
